    • refreshLocatedBlock

      protected LocatedBlock refreshLocatedBlock(LocatedBlock block) throws IOException
      The super method DFSInputStream.refreshLocatedBlock(org.apache.hadoop.hdfs.protocol.LocatedBlock) refreshes cached LocatedBlock by executing DFSInputStream.getBlockAt(long) again. This method extends the logic by first remembering the index of the internal block, and re-parsing the refreshed block group with the same index.
      Overrides:
      refreshLocatedBlock in class DFSInputStream
      Parameters:
      block - The currently cached block locations
      Returns:
      Refreshed block locations
